feedback: New feedback files are uploaded by authenticated mcloud handlers. Direct client writes to feedback paths are denied. Authorized owner/admin APIs provide temporary attachment URLs.
cms: Listed scenic content asset directories are publicly readable when a file ID is known. Record drafts remain protected by database rules and controller authorization. This template does not provide file-level privacy for CMS draft images.
legacy: Owner reads outside content directories are retained. Client writes are restricted to explicitly listed TRIP1 content, user and meet directories; inventory other active upload directories before applying. Feedback paths are not in the write allowlist.
deployment: Back up existing rules before applying. Verify private feedback access, temporary URLs and existing covers in a separate test environment. No live storage rules have been changed.
syntax: Explicit regex expressions only; no regex groups or negated .test(), matching the documented CloudBase rule grammar.

liveRule.source: WeChat developer tools cloud console / Storage / Permissions

publicMedia: Published content query responses append mediaUrls; original cloud IDs are preserved. URLs are scoped to the matching content record directory. Feedback and arbitrary client file ID signing are excluded.
administratorMedia: Authorized CMS read/upload and portal read handlers append adminMediaUrls with a requested 900-second expiry. Draft image URLs remain in the receiving management/administrator preview pages and are excluded from the shared visitor cache.
